name: Latte Coffee
description: Indulge in our rich and creamy Latte Coffee, crafted with a perfect blend of smooth espresso and steamed milk. Each sip offers a balanced harmony of bold coffee flavor and velvety texture, topped with a light layer of foam.

name: Cappuccino
description: A robust shot of espresso, perfectly balanced with steamed milk and topped with a generous layer of frothy milk foam. Served in a traditional 6-ounce cup with a sprinkle of cocoa or cinnamon on top.

name: Americano
description: Enjoy the simplicity and bold flavor of our Americano. Made with a single or double shot of our finest espresso, this coffee offers a smooth and robust taste. Perfect for those who prefer a lighter, longer drink.

name: Hot Chocolate
description: Treat yourself to the ultimate comfort with our decadent Hot Chocolate. Made with high-quality cocoa and steamed milk, rich, creamy, and perfectly sweet. Topped with whipped cream or marshmallows.

name: Irish Coffee
description: The perfect blend of warmth and flavor — freshly brewed hot coffee, smooth Irish whiskey, a touch of sugar, and a layer of lightly whipped cream. An exquisite after-dinner treat.

name: Classic Filter Coffee
description: Savor the pure, clean taste of our Filter Coffee. Using the finest quality beans through a precise drip process, ensuring a consistently smooth and flavorful cup. Enjoy it black or with a splash of milk.

name: Affogato
description: A classic Italian dessert-drink — a shot of hot espresso poured over a scoop of creamy vanilla gelato. The contrast of hot and cold, bitter and sweet, makes it an irresistible indulgence.

name: Cranberry Iced Coffee
description: A bold shot of espresso over ice, blended with tangy cranberry and a hint of citrus. Refreshing, fruity, and perfectly balanced for a summer afternoon pick-me-up.

name: Dalgona Coffee
description: The viral sensation — whipped instant coffee folded into a fluffy cloud and spooned over chilled milk. Stir it yourself and watch the magic happen with every sip.

name: Cold Brew Coffee
description: Slow-steeped for 12+ hours in cold water, our cold brew delivers a smooth, naturally sweet, and low-acidity coffee experience. Rich, bold, and incredibly refreshing served over ice.

name: Nitro Coffee
description: Our cold brew infused with nitrogen for a silky-smooth, creamy texture with a cascading effect right in the glass. Naturally sweet, no sugar needed — a unique coffee experience unlike any other.

name: Iced Mocha
description: Espresso meets rich chocolate syrup and cold milk, poured over ice and topped with whipped cream. A decadent treat for coffee-chocolate lovers who crave something cool and indulgent.

name: Lemon Mojito
description: A refreshing pairing of tangy lemon and crisp sweet mint. This is an easy drink that is perfect for sunny days and casual gatherings. Perfectly balanced and endlessly refreshing.

name: Strawberry Mojito
description: Fresh strawberries muddled with mint leaves, lime juice, and a splash of soda. Vibrant, fruity, and incredibly refreshing — a wonderful choice for summer.

name: Jamun Shots
description: A refreshing summer drink made with fresh Jamun (Java Plums), mint leaves, black salt, sugar, and lemon juice. Tangy, earthy, and deeply satisfying.

name: Mango Margarita
description: Frozen ripe mangoes blended with orange, lime, and agave. Cold, sweet, tangy, and subtly spiced. Perfect for warm weather and tropical vibes.

name: Watermelon Mojito
description: Super refreshing — made with fresh watermelon, mint, lime juice, and a splash of fizzy club soda. Perfect for patio days and lazy summer afternoons.

name: Mixed Mojito
description: A vibrant mixed berry mojito combining raspberries, blackberries, mint, lime, and soda. A riot of flavors in every sip — perfect for spring and summer gatherings.

name: Coffee & Cake
description: Your choice of any hot or cold coffee paired with a slice of our freshly baked cake of the day. A match made in heaven — the ultimate cafe indulgence for every occasion.

name: Coffee & Croissant
description: A warm, buttery, flaky croissant alongside your favourite coffee — the classic European breakfast combo. Perfectly paired for a relaxed morning or a productive work session.

name: Coffee & Cookie
description: A freshly brewed coffee served with two of our homemade cookies — chocolate chip, oatmeal raisin, or almond crunch. Simple pleasures, perfectly together.

name: Coffee & Sandwich
description: A hearty grilled sandwich — your choice of veg or classic fillings — paired with any coffee. A satisfying combo for a quick lunch or a leisurely brunch break.

name: Coffee & Dessert
description: End your meal on a high note — any coffee of your choice paired with our dessert of the day. Whether it's a brownie, cheesecake, or tart, this combo hits every time.

name: Friends Combo (2 Coffees)
description: Two coffees of your choice plus a shared snack plate. Perfect for catch-ups, meetings, or a cozy afternoon with a friend. Great value, even better memories.

name: White Chocolate
description: Smooth and creamy white chocolate made with the finest cocoa butter, milk solids and vanilla. Delightfully sweet with a melt-in-your-mouth texture — a classic indulgence for all chocolate lovers.

name: Milk Chocolate
description: Rich and velvety milk chocolate crafted with premium cocoa and fresh milk for a perfectly balanced sweetness. A timeless favourite that pairs beautifully with any hot or cold beverage.

name: Dark Chocolate
description: Intensely rich dark chocolate with a deep cocoa flavour and a satisfying snap. Made from single-origin beans, it's the perfect bittersweet treat for serious chocolate enthusiasts.

name: Ruby Chocolate
description: A rare and naturally pink chocolate with a unique fruity, berry-like flavour. Made from specially processed ruby cocoa beans — no added colours or fruit flavouring. A truly extraordinary experience.

name: Chocolate Syrup
description: A rich, glossy chocolate syrup made from premium cocoa — perfect for drizzling over ice creams, waffles, pancakes, or stirring into your favourite beverages. Indulgent in every drop.

name: Assorted Chocolates
description: A delightful curated box of mixed chocolates — dark, milk, white, and ruby — each with its own unique character. Perfect as a gift or a treat for yourself when you simply cannot choose just one.

name: Nutella Croissant
description: A warm, flaky butter croissant generously filled with smooth Nutella and lightly dusted with powdered sugar. A simple yet luxurious treat that pairs perfectly with any coffee.

name: Strawberry Pie
description: A golden, buttery pie shell filled with sweet, glossy fresh strawberries set in a light gel. Served chilled with a dollop of whipped cream — pure summer on a plate.

name: Orange Cheesecake
description: A creamy, velvety cheesecake bursting with bright orange flavor on a crunchy biscuit base. Light, smooth, and utterly refreshing — a dessert that feels like sunshine in every bite.

name: Sizzling Brownie
description: A rich, fudgy chocolate brownie served sizzling hot on a cast iron plate, topped with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. The theatrical combo of hot and cold is absolutely irresistible.

name: Blueberry Ice Cream
description: Creamy, homemade-style blueberry ice cream loaded with real fruit pieces. Intensely flavored, beautifully purple, and cooling — a dessert that's as pretty as it is delicious.

name: Lemon Tart
description: A delightful blend of tangy and sweet — a crisp, buttery pastry shell filled with smooth lemony custard. Finished with a light dusting of powdered sugar. Refreshing and elegant in every bite.

name: Arabica Coffee Beans
description: Medium roast with notes of caramel and fruit. Costa Rica Tarrazu ground coffee. Hand-carved wooden scoop included.

name: Filter Coffee Powder
description: Pure and aromatic filter coffee powder. Perfect for your morning ritual, sourced from the finest estates.

name: Liberica Coffee Beans
description: Rare and unique beans with a rich, woody aroma. Notes of dark chocolate and light floral hints.

name: Coffee Pack of 6
description: Turn your coffee break into a relaxing daily ritual. Includes Costa Rica Tarrazu ground coffee, vanilla shortbread cookies, and a hand-carved wooden scoop.

name: Coffee Pack of 3
description: The perfect gift for the coffee connoisseur. Includes a coffee mug, coffee mix, bag clip, chocolate-covered coffee beans, soy wax candle, and cozy spa socks.

name: Thermo Coffee Tumbler
description: Vacuum insulated steel tumbler. Keeps your coffee hot for hours — ideal for cold brew, latte, and mocha.

name: Coffee Glass
description: Elegant borosilicate glass for cold brew and iced coffee. Heat-safe, durable, and a lovely everyday essential.

name: Coffee Filter
description: Premium reusable coffee filter for a clean, eco-friendly brew. Compatible with most standard drip coffee makers.

name: Gift Hamper - Coffee Lover
description: Turn your coffee break into a relaxing daily ritual. Costa Rica Tarrazu ground coffee, vanilla shortbread cookies, and a hand-carved wooden scoop.

name: Gift Card Rs.500
description: The perfect gift for the coffee connoisseur — or a treat for yourself. Includes a coffee mug, coffee mix, bag clip, chocolate-covered coffee beans, soy wax candle, encouragement cards, postcard, and cozy spa socks.

name: Premium Coffee Box
description: A rich cold brew dark chocolate blend, vanilla latte milk chocolate with espresso notes, almond and cashew butter dark chocolate, classic mocha, and a coffee & caramel tasting library.
